validate_environment: validate the OpenRouter embedding environment and return merged headers with authorization, referer, and title
get_complete_url: build the complete OpenRouter embedding API URL from api_base and model parameters
transform_embedding_request: transform embedding input and model name into OpenRouter-compatible request format
transform_embedding_response: transform raw HTTP response into a LiteLLM embedding model response object
map_openai_params: map supported OpenAI embedding parameters into optional params for OpenRouter
